messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "12.5 mg dose may be sufficient for many patients"
set: ["12.5 mg dose may be sufficient for many patients", "Patients may be switched to the extended-release 450 mg dose", "lower dose may be needed for older adults", "12.5 mg dose may have less frequent low potassium compared to 25 mg", "dose may be gradually increased", "starting dose of 12.5 mg is recommended for adults over 65", "These patients may be taking any formulation", "dose may be increased to 14 mg once daily", "splitting the dose may be needed", "lower dose may be an option", "patients should be periodically reassessed for the appropriate dose of treatment", "starting dose is 12.5 mg capsule once a day", "may be repeated at the same dose", "dose prescribed by your doctor may be used", "taking a larger daily dose may be needed", "dose adjustments or alternative treatments may be available"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
